title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role

Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered . This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.

We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.

⭐ What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive
Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content
Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience
Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar
Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs
Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach
Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)
  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates
You’re a Great Fit If You…
  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines
⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar

  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction

Bonus:

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.
  • Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.
  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.(No mínimo nível intermediário).
  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Gerente de EHS

Resumo da Posição:

O Gerente de EHS é responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter programas de meio ambiente, saúde e segurança, garantindo conformidade com todas as regulamentações aplicáveis. Este papel promove um ambiente de trabalho seguro e sustentável, impulsionando a melhoria contínua no desempenho de EHS, com foco em processos químicos e operações envolvendo gases.

  • Desenvolver e aplicar políticas, procedimentos e padrões de EHS.

  • Ministrar treinamentos e programas de conscientização em EHS para colaboradores.
  • Manter registros precisos e preparar relatórios de conformidade.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato com órgãos reguladores e auditores externos.
  • Monitorar indicadores de EHS e recomendar melhorias.

Qualificações:

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciências Ambientais, Segurança do Trabalho, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 5 anos em gestão de EHS ou função similar, com atuação em processos químicos e gases.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Setores desejados: Indústria química, agronegócio, papel e celulose, óleo e gás.
  • Certificações: Desejável CSP, CIH, ISO14001, OHSAS18001.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

description:

We are seeking an Electrical Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. This role focuses on the design, development, and testing of electrical and electronic systems for new products, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The specialist will collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and cost-competitive products.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with suppliers to develop and qualify electrical components, ensuring alignment with production requirements.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on optimizing product quality and cost, ensuring product reliability, cost competitiveness, and customer satisfaction.

  • Perform electrical testing, validation, and troubleshooting to guarantee compliance with safety standards and technical specifications.
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, including schematics, test procedures, and reports.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams—including mechanical, software, quality, and manufacturing—to integrate electrical systems effectively.
  • Liaise with suppliers and external partners to source components and resolve technical challenges.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment.
  • Proficiency with electrical design software (e.g., CAD, simulation tools) and testing equipment.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical safety standards and product certification processes.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel as necessary.

Differentials:

  • Experience in the home appliance, HVAC, or durable goods industries.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Quem somos?

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency

Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements

Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Ter disponibilidade para viagens.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

title: Merchant Informatization Lead
description:
Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do:

  • Managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy.
  • Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  • Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  • Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.

What We Need From You:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Team management experience, preferably within food delivery CX or CS, or BPOs.
  • Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  • Understand team goal management and data analysis, and be proficient in data analysis tools.
  • Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  • A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Arquiteto(a) de RPA - Automation Anywhere - Brasil
description:

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior empresa de serviços profissionais do mundo como Arquiteto de RPA no time de Engineering . Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Servir como um integrador entre as necessidades de negócios e as soluções de tecnologia, ajudando a criar soluções de tecnologia para atender às necessidades de negócios.

  • Avaliação e otimização de arquitetura de aplicativos, incluindo definição, documentação e implementação de novas arquiteturas de aplicativos;
  • Direcionar construção nas fábricas contratadas, concepção de solução, modelagem de dados e construção de APIs;

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

O que você precisa para se candidatar à vaga?

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Física ou Química; ou graduação em nível superior em qualquer área de conhecimento acrescida de curso de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) com duração mínima de 360 horas na área de conhecimento de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Experiência profissional mínima de 7 (sete) anos como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor ou cargo correlato
  • Certificação Master na ferramenta Automation Anywhere ou similar (de nível mais alto) em outra plataforma.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida

title: Telecommunications Project Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager in the Telecommunications sector to lead complex initiatives involving network deployment, modernization, and expansion. This professional will be responsible for delivering projects on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards, while ensuring strong alignment between clients, technical teams, vendors, and senior management.

This is a full on-site position at our São Paulo – Berrini office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close telecom projects (RAN, Core, IP, FTTH, DWDM, power and site infrastructure).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and quality indicators (SLAs, KPIs), ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams (engineering, deployment, logistics, suppliers, and subcontractors).
  • Lead regular meetings with telecom operators and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency, governance, and alignment.
  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate technical, operational, and commercial risks.
  • Prepare and present executive reports to clients and senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and key decisions.
  • Ensure compliance with telecom regulations (e.g., ANATEL) and international quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, aiming at efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Telecommunications, or related areas is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in project management, with a strong background in the telecommunications sector.
  • Solid experience in project management within the telecommunications sector (mobile networks, fixed networks, or backbone).
  • Strong technical knowledge of telecom technologies (4G/5G RAN, IP/MPLS, DWDM, FTTH, power and infrastructure for telecom sites).
  • Proven experience managing projects of high complexity, involving multiple vendors and Tier-1 telecom operators.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile, hybrid).
  • Certifications are a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, ITIL.
  • English is the primary working language; fluency is required. Portuguese fluency both written and spoken is a must.
  • Availability to work full on-site at the São Paulo – Berrini office.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strong leadership skills and ability to engage technical and field teams.
  • Excellent negotiation skills with clients, partners, and vendors.
  • Established professional relationship with major Brazilian telecom operators (TIM, Claro, Vivo, Oi/Algar) is highly desirable.
  • Analytical thinking and result-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work under pressure in demanding and dynamic environments.
  • Clear and structured communication for both technical and executive audiences.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead high-impact projects for major telecom operators.
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with direct interface with international stakeholders.
  • Competitive compensation package and continuous training programs.

  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.

O que nós estamos procurando;

  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.  
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)

  1. Do you live in  BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  2. Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? 
  3. Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? 
  4. Can you type both fast and accurately? 
  5. Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and your income up to R$28,000 per month? 
  6. Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? 
  7. Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  8. Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  9. Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  10. Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 

Regardless of what you studied in a university or the type and duration of your work experience,   this is a rare opportunity for you to build your career from step 1 in a Junior or Assistant position. You are expected to learn the job quickly to become competent in the work that we do, and promote to the next position , usually after only 12 months of learning the entire investigation process.  

We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

The HR & Investigation Assistant position may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:

·   High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

Minimum Education/Experience Requirements

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are  required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is  required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is  required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is  required.  
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is  preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is  preferred.   

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are  required.  
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is  required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English. 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is  required.  
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is  required.   
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is  preferred.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is  required.  A Master's Degree is  preferred.  

GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application

Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.

STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

· Your current/updated resume in English.

· A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.

· Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in currency) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.

STEP #2: We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)

You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.

Please send your complete application as soon as possible. We are coordinating interviews now!

title: Gerente Financeiro
description:
Qual é o desafio?

Buscamos uma liderança de Finanças hands-on e com experiência comprovada em Centros de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) para assumir a gestão e a transformação de uma área estratégica em uma empresa de grande porte.

O desafio central é a reestruturação completa dos processos e a liderança de uma grande equipe, com foco em eficiência, automação e parceria com as operações regionais Latam.

Responsabilidades :

  • Mapeamento e Automação: Liderar o mapeamento detalhado de todos os processos do CSC, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de automação (RPA, soluções de mercado).
  • Melhoria Contínua: Implementar metodologias (Lean, Six Sigma) para garantir a melhoria contínua dos SLAs e KPIs da área.
  • Compliance e Risco: Assegurar a aderência total às políticas internas, regulamentações fiscais e normas contábeis, mitigando riscos operacionais e de compliance nas transações regionais.
  • Gestão de Stakeholders: Ser o ponto focal e estratégico para a liderança executiva e áreas parceiras, garantindo que os serviços financeiros suportem a estratégia de crescimento da empresa.
  • Supervisionar a Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa diário e a conciliação bancária das operações, garantindo liquidez e otimização de recursos.
  • Gerenciar o Hub de Pagamentos, assegurando a precisão, a pontualidade e a segurança de todos os desembolsos da companhia, incluindo pagamentos internacionais.
  • Assegurar a eficiência de todo o ciclo da compra até o pagamento, incluindo a gestão de notas fiscais (Recebimento Fiscal), processamento de faturas e relacionamento com fornecedores.
  • Otimizar o processo de aprovação e pagamento para reduzir o DPO (Days Payable Outstanding), quando aplicável, e manter um bom relacionamento com a base de fornecedores.
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de Recebimento de Valores , desde a emissão da cobrança até a compensação financeira, garantindo o controle rigoroso dos valores a receber.
  • Trabalhar na redução da inadimplência e na melhoria do DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) , em parceria com as áreas Comercial e de Crédito.
  • Estrutura e Performance: Redesenhar a estrutura organizacional da área para maior eficiência e responsabilidade, definindo KPIs claros para os coordenadores e equipes.
  • Gestão de Crises: Atuar ativamente na resolução de conflitos e problemas complexos, especialmente aqueles que afetam as operações da Latam, recuperando a confiança dos clientes internos .
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver um grande time , fornecendo direcionamento e elevando a performance.

Requisitos :

  • Experiência Comprovada: Sólida vivência na liderança e gestão de Centros de Serviços Compartilhados (SSC/CSC) ou grandes áreas de Operações Financeiras.
  • Liderança de Grande Escala: Experiência mandatória na gestão de times de grande port .
  • Expertise em Processos: Profundo conhecimento e experiência em PTP ( Procure-to-Pay ) e OTC ( Order-to-Cash ) e seus ciclos completos (da compra ao pagamento e do pedido ao recebimento).
  • Transformação e Otimização: Histórico de sucesso em mapeamento e melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma, ou similares), com foco em automação e eficiência.
  • Experiência Internacional: Vivência e conhecimento em operações e processos financeiros de países da América Latina (Latam) .
  • Idioma: Espanhol avançado é mandatório (capacidade de participar de discussões de alto nível e complexidade com a liderança regional).

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence () is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.

Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page .

You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.

Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.

Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.

The Job

You will manage multiple projects per day.

Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).

Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).

Here’s how you will interact with a project:

Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus

Working Hours & Location

  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home ( WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off

title: Senior Business Analyst - Incentive Planning
description:

Collaborate with sales teams to evaluate execution effectiveness, identify gaps, and iteratively refine sales strategies to ensure solution viability.
  3. System & Process Optimization: Optimize performance management systems and processes, and partner with the product team to build tools that enhance efficiency.

  1. experience in business analysis or data analysis is preferred, with experience in performance evaluation, target design, or sales strategy preferred.

  4. Strong work planning skills, meticulous, and highly responsible for deliverables.

  1. Target performance is one of the key levers to drive the sales team to achieve the company's overall goals, with strong implementation feasibility.

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A foi criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: ESPECIALISTA EN MECÁNICA DE ROCAS, con conocimiento en pastefill.

PROPÓSITO Liderar y supervisar proyectos geotécnicos de relleno de excavaciones, garantizando la seguridad y estabilidad de la mina subterránea, así como la búsqueda de la máxima recuperación del mineral, aplicando su conocimiento especializado en métodos diferenciados de relleno cementado y no cementado. Coordinar las interacciones entre las diferentes áreas para asegurar el cumplimiento del cronograma de relleno de las excavaciones, de acuerdo con los requisitos de producción de la mina.

RESPONSABILIDADES Y ATRIBUCIONES
  • Desarrollar el proyecto de mezcla de pastefill para cada especificación de exposición de pasta.
  • Conducir estudios de mezcla, selección de materiales e investigaciones en laboratorio.
  • Actuar junto con los planificadores de mina para conducir los proyectos de relleno de excavaciones a corto, mediano y largo plazo.
  • Implementar QA/QC para pastefill y otros métodos de relleno.
  • Capacitar al equipo de laboratorio en control de calidad para pastefill .
  • Desarrollar KPIs y actuar en mejora continua con base en las metas definidas.
  • Planificar zonas de exclusión, barricadas y áreas de construcción.
  • Definir métodos de monitoreo/instrumentación del sistema de relleno y barricadas.
  • Desarrollar el Plan de Gestión de Relleno de Excavaciones.
  • Implementar métodos de monitoreo y gestión de vacíos.
  • Ser responsable por la elaboración de informes de calidad y notas técnicas ( stope notes ) de relleno de cada realce.
  • Apoyar en el análisis, actualización y calibración del sistema de distribución de pastefill .
  • Comunicar los procesos y procedimientos de relleno de excavaciones a las áreas relevantes.
  • Actuar en la optimización de las características del relleno, buscando aumentar la disponibilidad y utilización del sistema, mejorar la resistencia, reducir costos y reforzar la seguridad operacional.
  • Identificar riesgos potenciales y desarrollar estrategias de mitigación.
  • Realizar inspecciones y auditorías regulares para verificar la conformidad con las especificaciones.
REQUISITOS Y CALIFICACIONES Requisitos obligatorios:
  • Titulación en Geología, Ingeniería de Minas o Ingeniería Geológica.
  • Registro profesional activo (CREA o equivalente aplicable).
  • Idioma: inglés avanzado.
  • Licencia de conducir categoría B.
  • Conocimiento en métodos de minería (VRM, Open Stope , Cámaras y Pilares).
  • Experiencia en el área.
Requisitos deseables:

title: M&A Business Development/Sourcing (Coordinator)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!

Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.

#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

Missão do cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa coordenadora para atuar estrategicamente na identificação, originação e desenvolvimento de oportunidades de investimento e aquisições que acelerem o crescimento da TOTVS, garantindo aderência à estratégia corporativa e aos mapas de crescimento das unidades de negócio, por meio de relacionamento qualificado com o ecossistema de inovação e análise inicial estruturada dos potenciais targets.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Identificar, gerar e desenvolver oportunidades de novos investimentos e aquisições alinhadas à estratégia corporativa da TOTVS e às prioridades de crescimento das unidades de negócio.
  • Construir, estruturar e manter um pipeline qualificado de targets, com prospecção ativa, critérios claros de priorização e acompanhamento disciplinado das oportunidades.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento contínuo com startups, founders, advisors, fundos de investimento, universidades e hubs de inovação, ampliando e fortalecendo a rede de originação da companhia.
  • Conduzir os primeiros contatos e reuniões com potenciais targets, apresentando de forma clara o posicionamento estratégico da TOTVS, bem como avaliando rapidamente o nível de interesse, o alinhamento estratégico (fit) e o momento de maturidade do negócio.
  • Realizar análises preliminares dos negócios prospectados, considerando modelo de negócio (especialmente SaaS), produto, mercado, tese de crescimento e indicadores financeiros básicos, aplicando senso crítico e visão estratégica quanto à aderência e potenciais sinergias.
  • Participar ativamente de eventos, visitas técnicas, reuniões externas e roadshows, representando institucionalmente a TOTVS e fortalecendo a geração contínua de oportunidades de originação.
  • Preparar materiais executivos e sintéticos para o time de M&A, consolidando racional estratégico, principais riscos, oportunidades e recomendações iniciais, além de manter o pipeline organizado, atualizado e reportado de forma estruturada.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Finanças, Engenharia, Exatas ou áreas correlatas, com tempo de formação entre 5 e 10 anos, compatível com o nível da posição
  • Experiência prévia em Business Development, M&A, Corporate Venture, Venture Capital, consultoria estratégica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Forte rede de relacionamento no ecossistema de tecnologia, startups, fundos e advisors ou alta capacidade comprovada de construir e expandir relacionamentos estratégicos de forma ágil.
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo, com excelente capacidade de comunicação, influência e postura executiva e comercial para interação com líderes, founders e stakeholders seniores.
  • Disponibilidade e facilidade para viagens, participação em eventos e atuação majoritariamente externa.
  • Conhecimento sólido de modelos de negócio de tecnologia.
  • Experiência ou entendimento de SaaS será considerado diferencial.
  • Elevado nível de organização, disciplina na gestão de pipeline e forte capacidade de síntese para discussões com liderança executiva.

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo/SP

title: ANALISTA PROJETOS SR - ESTUDO DE VIABILIDADE
description:

Atua de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, utilizando modelagem financeira e indicadores para embasar decisões executivas.   • Calcular e interpretar indicadores financeiros como ROI, TIR, VPL, entre outros;
  • Analisar a rentabilidade de produtos e os resultados de novos projetos, propondo ajustes e melhorias;

  • Manter relacionamento próximo com áreas parceiras, promovendo boa comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental;
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e validação com stakeholders internos;
  • Demonstrar proatividade na identificação de riscos, oportunidades e melhorias nos projetos em análise.

REQUISITOS

  • Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas afins;
  • Modelagem Financeira avançada e avaliação de investimentos;
  • DRE, fluxo de caixa, custos e despesas;
  • Indicadores financeiros: ROI, TIR, VPL;
  • Excel avançado, Power BI, PowerPoint;
  • Vivência em controladoria e/ou planejamento financeiro;
  • Projeções financeiras de curto e longo prazo;
  • Ferramentas de colaboração: Miro;

  • Transporte Fretado;
  • Wellhub;

title: Coordenador de Segurança e Estacionamento

title: Bolsista Doutor - Indusbello - Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais| Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Indusbello é uma empresa brasileira referência nos setores odontológico, hospitalar e veterinário, reconhecida por sua atuação inovadora na fabricação de produtos que aliam alta performance, segurança e responsabilidade socioambiental.

Com sede em Londrina (PR) e presença consolidada em mais de 30 países, a Indusbello investe fortemente em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e tecnologia, consolidando-se como uma das marcas líderes em soluções para a saúde.

Seu compromisso com a qualidade, a ética e a inovação contínua norteiam sua atuação no mercado há mais de três décadas. A empresa possui certificações internacionais como ISO 9001, ISO 13485, marcação CE e aprovação de produtos pelo FDA.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Administração, Engenharia da Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia da Automação ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais, com foco em aumento da competitividade, redução de custos e inovação tecnológica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Planejar e desenvolver projetos de estruturação e modelagem de processos industriais;

description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

  • Participar ativamente do desenho de arquiteturas de dados e IA em ambientes híbridos e multicloud.

O que valorizamos

Pensamento sistêmico e foco em entrega de valor: profissionais que enxergam o todo, priorizam impacto e entregam com consistência.

Inovação e automação com propósito: pessoas movidas por curiosidade técnica, que buscam simplificar o complexo, escalar processos e transformar dados em inteligência real.

Equilíbrio entre profundidade técnica e visão estratégica: quem domina a execução hands-on, mas também influencia decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas.

Requisitos

  • +7 anos de experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Dados ;
  • Sólida experiência em AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, S3, ECS/EKS);
  • Domínio em Snowflake (modelagem, performance tuning, data sharing);
  • Conhecimento avançado em MLOps (CI/CD de modelos, MLflow, Kubeflow ou similares);
  • Proficiência em Python (pandas, pyspark, boto3), SQL e infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou CloudFormation);
  • Experiência em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster);
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de DataOps e observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, alertas).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em governança de modelos e dados (lineage, RBAC, tagging);
  • Conhecimentos em Dremio, Databricks ou Redshift ;
  • Vivência em arquiteturas Data Mesh ou orientadas a domínios ;
  • Atuação prévia em times com metodologia ágil e cultura DevOps .

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação PJ

  • Ambiente colaborativo, com liberdade técnica , autonomia de decisão e foco em inovação e impacto real

Estamos construindo um ecossistema de dados que sustenta o crescimento de uma das maiores plataformas digitais da América Latina.

Aqui, você vai projetar pipelines em escala continental , colaborar com cientistas e engenheiros de alto nível, e entregar soluções que realmente movem o negócio .

title: PESSOA ANALISTA DE FROTAS JR- AFIRMATIVA PARA PESSOAS NEGRAS
description:

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the São Paulo airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

Novos Negócios: Liderar a identificação, validação e execução de novas oportunidades de crescimento, conectando análises de mercado, comportamento de clientes e movimentos competitivos à criação de novos produtos, modelos de negócio e frentes de receita. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

Informações adicionais

title: Analista de integração
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).
  • Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#).
  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).
  • Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).

O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Storage
  • Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Git/GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Criação e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Segurança com OAuth2 e JWT.
  • Integrações entre diferentes plataformas.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e SOLID.
  • Escrita de código limpo e documentação técnica.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.
